# If one person left tomorrow, which folders would nobody understand?

> Paste your git log and see the bus factor (truck factor) of every folder: who really owns it, whether they are still active, and who to pair with. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/git-bus-factor-check/)
- [What is a bus factor (truck factor), and how do you raise it?](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/git-bus-factor-check/what-is-bus-factor.html)
